property_summary: For every caller address, calling owned() on the correct contract C never succeeds (reverts for non-owner or does nothing for owner) so that a try/catch indicates the call does not unexpectedly succeed for non-owners; the mutant inverts the ownership check allowing some non-owner callers to successfully execute owned(), breaking this rule.
change_summary: Replace require check in onlyOwner modifier to inverted check so non-owners become allowed and owner remains unchanged after owned() only if caller is owner; this changes whether owned() can be executed and thus whether state changes happen.
